description: Repairs r-cursor-1b/find-text-quotes: S = 'O''Brien' gave NoMatch while the same pattern on Q matched, and the NoMatch was not isolated from the IX_S index on S. On a dynaset over FU (IDs 1-8; N 10,20,30,40,40,50,60,70; S alpha, beta, O'Brien, a"b, abc, ABC, abd, Null; Q x, Null, x, Null, y, Null, x, y; P the plain values p1-p8; no index but the key) and then on a dynaset over FI (the same rows with a nonunique index on S), for each criterion [S = 'alpha' ;; S = 'ALPHA' ;; S = 'alpha ' ;; S = 'O''Brien' ;; S = "O'Brien" ;; S = 'O'Brien' ;; S = 'a"b' ;; S = "a""b" ;; S = "a"b" ;; S = ''' ;; S = '' ;; S = "" ;; S = 'abc' ;; S > 'abc' ;; S < 'b' ;; S = [S] ;; S = 'Zed' ;; [S] = 'beta' ;; S = 'beta ;; S = beta ;; S = 'be' & 'ta' ;; S = 'a' + 'lpha' ;; S = Left('alphabet', 5) ;; P = 'p1' ;; P = 'P1' ;; P = 'p1 ' ;; P > 'p3' ;; [P] = 'p2'] (the criteria on P are plain-value controls): FindFirst, read Errors, then FindNext x1 with the same criterion; after each call read NoMatch, BOF, EOF and ID. Asks quote and escape handling in text criteria, case and trailing-space comparison, comparison operators on text, field-to-field and function-built text, and which malformed texts are refused, with the second match after FindNext, on the indexed and the unindexed column. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
